manifest.label: Equity prices for performance baskets and returns table
manifest.unit: dividend-adjusted close; published only as indexed levels and percentage returns

notes: Alberta Economic Dashboard data are released under the Open Government Licence - Alberta.
Equity prices come from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance package; the published bundle contains only indexed levels and percentage returns, no price levels.
Bank of Canada (Valet API) supplies the Canadian dollar exchange rate, used only to express the Alberta gas price in US$/MMBtu.
Baker Hughes weekly rig counts are not fetched: the download requires a browser session; EIA monthly rig counts are used instead.
